subject: Upcoming Team Building Event: RSVP Required
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce our upcoming team building event scheduled for next month. The event will include various team-building activities, games, and a catered lunch. To ensure we have an accurate headcount for catering purposes, please RSVP by clicking on the provided link by the end of this week. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
